headline: Competitive intelligence matrix & defensible advantage analysis for 10 major competitors; identified 2 moats
highlights: SwagUp, Swag.com, Stadium, Printful, Printfection, Brilliant, Merchology, Bonusly, Karma, Bulu Box
Branded Fit identified in unique upper-right quadrant: <10min provisioning + 95% fidelity + $24K/yr
Defensible Advantage #1: Autonomous brand extraction (Brandfetch API) - no competitor has replicated
Defensible Advantage #2: Enterprise fidelity at mid-market pricing (3-7x cheaper than Merchology)
No direct competitor identified; Merchology is closest (custom design) but 21-28 days slower
Competitive positioning ready for GTM messaging: '3x faster + 2-3x cheaper than Merchology'
Economic moat: Brandfetch licensing ($20-30K/yr) too expensive for SMB competitors to justify
Threat assessment: Bonusly & Brilliant (Workday) are medium risk 18-month horizon
Created 3 comprehensive research documents for sales & marketing enablement
All competitor data sourced from public websites, not proprietary research
